user.title: Connect a venue
user.description: Create an API token on the venue's host dashboard under Settings → Integrations, then paste it here.

data_description.base_url: Where your UncTunes server lives, e.g. https://unctunes.example.com
data_description.token: Starts with ut_. Shown once when you create it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {venue}
reauth_confirm.description: The venue rejected its API token. Create a new one on the host dashboard and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the UncTunes server at that URL.
error.wrong_venue: That token belongs to a different venue.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This venue is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the venue's queue and player state, in seconds.

request_song.name: Request a song
request_song.description: Adds a song to the venue's queue, by Spotify track URI or by searching.

config_entry_id.name: Venue
config_entry_id.description: Which venue to queue on. Optional when only one venue is set up.

query.name: Search
query.description: Free-text Spotify search; the top result is queued.

uri.name: Track URI
uri.description: A spotify:track: URI, an open.spotify.com track link, or a bare track id. Wins over Search when both are given.

priority.name: Play next
priority.description: Put the song at the front of the queue instead of the back.

requester.name: Requested by
requester.description: Name shown next to the song in the queue. Defaults to Home Assistant.

search.name: Search Spotify
search.description: Searches Spotify through the venue and returns matching tracks.

config_entry_id.name: Venue
config_entry_id.description: Which venue to search through. Optional when only one venue is set up.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return.
